note: Google reviews are for company office profiles on Google Maps; app-store and Trustpilot scores are listed alongside. A site is used only if it is a real, operating company with current whole-home rental inventory in the target area.

sites.name: NoBroker
sites.operator: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru). Founded 2013-14 by Akhil Gupta, Amit Kumar Agarwal, Saurabh Garg. Unicorn since Nov 2021 ($210M Series E led by General Atlantic, Tiger Global, Moore Strategic Ventures). Private, VC-backed.

ratings.platform: Google reviews (HQ, Sarjapur Main Rd, Bengaluru)
ratings.note: Google Maps listing currently has review posting turned off
Rating withheld: 'unavailable due to a breach of our guidelines'; Trustpilot says it removed a number of fake reviews. Star split 47% 5-star / 39% 1-star

sites.strengths: Owner-listed (no-brokerage) model; Royapuram page describes listings as 'NoBroker verified owner-listed rental homes'. Best north-Chennai coverage found: 3BHK rental pages live for Royapuram (5+), Old Washermanpet (4+), Tondiarpet (7+), Perambur (21+), Purasaiwakkam (10+), Kilpauk (10+), Vepery (48+), Egmore (5+). Sample Royapuram 3BHKs at Rs 19k-40k/month. Very actively maintained app.
sites.risks: Trustpilot withheld its rating for guideline breach and removed fake reviews (review-manipulation signal). Many consumer complaints about paid tenant/owner plans, refunds, token-advance disputes (voxya, consumercomplaints.in). Brokers sometimes pose as owners despite the model. Owner contact gated behind paid plan / free-contact quota.
sites.reason: Large, well-funded operator with owner-verified listings and the deepest live 3BHK rental inventory across every target north/central Chennai locality.

sites.name: 99acres
sites.operator: Info Edge (India) Ltd (NSE/BSE-listed; also owns Naukri, Jeevansathi, Shiksha). 99acres launched Sept 2005.

ratings.platform: Google reviews (99acres Sales Office Egmore, Chennai)
Google reviews (Info Edge corporate office, Sector 132 Noida)
ratings.note: Rating shown, review count not exposed in Maps data
~95% 1-star; profile not inviting reviews, so skewed to complainants

sites.strengths: Oldest Indian property portal, owned by a listed company with audit/governance obligations. Live north/central Chennai rental pages, e.g. 'Kilpauk 3 BHK flats for rent 24+' and 64+ flats for rent in Kilpauk; listings carry owner/dealer tag and a 'Verified' badge on some listings.
sites.risks: Most rental listings in central Chennai are dealer (broker)-posted. Trustpilot complaints: 'verified' tag applied to broker listings without owner consent, stale/already-let listings left up, paid-plan non-delivery. Sept 2025 whistle-blower complaint about some 99acres employees (Info Edge appointed a law firm to investigate; no material financial impact stated). Site blocks automated fetching, so per-locality counts beyond Kilpauk could not be confirmed directly.
sites.reason: Listed-company operator with substantial central-Chennai 3BHK rental inventory; broker-heavy, so tag listings by poster type.

sites.reason: Legitimate operator but an unverified free-classifieds marketplace with recurring advance-payment rental scams; usable only as leads that are verified in person with no payment before a visit.

sites.name: ChennaiProperties
sites.operator: Chennai-based local portal, operating since 2014 as chennaiproperties.in; moved to chennaiproperties.com on 1 July 2026 (per its own press release). Office at Okkiyam Thoraipakkam, Chennai.
sites.strengths: Chennai-only focus; locality rent pages exist for all target localities; 3BHK rent listings seen in Kilpauk (e.g. 1,650 sq ft Rs 60k/month), Egmore (1,619 sq ft Rs 60k), Purasawalkam and Vepery.
sites.risks: Small operator, no independent reviews beyond 42 Google reviews; legitimacy claims come from paid press release; appears to be primarily a sale/new-project portal; Royapuram/Perambur/Tondiarpet/Washermanpet rent pages showed little or no 3BHK inventory; unclear owner verification.
sites.reason: Real local Chennai portal with some central-Chennai 3BHK rentals, but small and weakly evidenced - use as a secondary source.

sites.name: Makaan.com
